description: An unscheduled EVA was conducted specifically to test two suit modifications: an improvised external sun visor (to aid helmet ventilation and visibility against a low sun angle) and a separately repaired suit's waist/upper-leg interface (which had undergone extensive prior patch repairs). The sun visor proved effective; the suit repair was found to restrict mobility and need further modification.
response: The sun visor was adopted going forward. The repaired suit was flagged for further modification before use on a working EVA.
lesson: Test suit modifications on a short, dedicated EVA before relying on them for a working science EVA — this surfaced the suit-repair mobility problem cheaply, before it could affect a real objective.
pattern_tag: improvised sun visor for EVA helmets
